breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting boundary conditions. The original prompt incorrectly specified both simply-supported (u=0, Δu=0) and Neumann (∂u/∂n = 0) conditions. The agent correctly discarded the contradictory Neumann condition and only included the simply-supported conditions, which is consistent with the ground truth.
